sentence: This project tests how a major stress response pathway leads to nitroarene activation and to changes in proteins and DNA.
This project studies how environmental conditions affect toxins produced by Alexandrium that accumulate in shellfish.
This project studies how RNA-binding proteins work in the biology of Plasmodium, the parasite that causes malaria.
This project studies how to carry out colorectal cancer screening in publicly funded health systems and integrated care for rapid breast cancer diagnosis.
This project follows a large cohort of patients with peripheral artery disease to learn about survival, outcomes and the impact of treatments.
This project builds a clinical decision support tool that uses artificial intelligence to predict and prevent hypoglycemia in hospitalized patients with diabetes.
This project studies the neural circuit mechanisms behind seizure susceptibility in a mouse model of Angelman syndrome.
This project builds a tissue engineering model of niche remodeling to expand hematopoietic stem cells ex vivo.
This project looks for differences in genes and gene networks that explain why Cryptococcus isolates vary in disease related traits.
This project builds a technology framework that uses extracellular vesicles in the blood to monitor the health impact of environmental exposures.
This project maps cellular and molecular changes in brain tissue from normal aging and Alzheimer's disease using imaging mass spectrometry and microscopy.
This project studies how to reprogram T cell function with genome engineering and builds protein chimeras for targeted degradation.
This project studies how medial entorhinal and hippocampal circuits break down as memory deficits progress in three mouse models of Alzheimer's disease pathology.
This project uses high-throughput sequencing to measure gene expression, T cell receptors and epigenetics profiles in T cell subsets from patients with lung pathogens.
This project develops doped graphene quantum dots that work as contrast agents for ultrasound and fluorescence imaging.
This project studies how a ciliary traffic protein helps make a cilium and keeps receptors inside the cilium.
This project maps enhancer activity and uses deep learning models to study gene regulation in heart development at single-cell resolution.
This project coordinates and supports research on bone marrow failure in children through study sites.
This project studies how a pathway causes cardiac microvascular barrier dysfunction and heart failure during sepsis.
This project studies the three-dimensional structures and mechanisms of ion channels and enzymatic membrane proteins in cellular membranes.
